name: British Association of Singapore
summary: Nationality association for Brits and friends — soft-landing events, community notices, and a lighter alternative to country-club membership.
body: The British Association of Singapore is a nationality-community layer rather than a full sports club: events, notices, and soft-landing introductions for British and Commonwealth-adjacent households. It pairs well with BritCham when you need professional adjacency and with British Club or Hollandse-style memberships when you need facilities. Use it for week-one calendar density — festival gatherings, family meetups, newcomer briefings — then decide whether a paid membership club still earns its keep. Forum ‘make friends as a foreigner’ advice often points at nationality associations before InterNations mixers; show up twice before judging the room.
membershipNotes: Association dues are typically far below country-club entrance fees — confirm live categories and event access for non-members.
